title: Voyager 1 Reaches One Light-Day From Earth
paragraphs: Voyager 1 is a small space probe. It left Earth in 1977.
On 18 November 2026, it was one light-day from Earth. Light needs one day to travel this far.
Radio signals take about 24 hours to reach us. Engineers on Earth do not get new data now. But they still hear a weak signal.

questions.q: How long does a radio signal take to reach Earth?
Does the team still hear a signal?
